title: Drainage System Inspection Checklist
description: Used for monthly routine drainage inspections and semi-annual CEC structural assessments. Completed form submitted to OM.

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: Runway 07 end drainage swale clear of sediment, vegetation, and debris
Runway 25 end drainage swales clear of sediment, vegetation, and debris
Runway east edge drainage channel (full length) free of blockage
Runway west edge drainage channel (full length) free of blockage
Runway drainage outlets water discharging freely to aerodrome drainage network
No ponding adjacent to runway edges 1 hour after end of rainfall
No erosion channels created by surface water at runway edges
Taxiway Alpha drainage channels (east and west) clear, flowing
Taxiway Bravo drainage gutters clear
Taxiway Charlie drainage gutters clear
No standing water on any taxiway surface 30 min after end of rainfall
All apron drainage channels clear and unobstructed
All apron drainage sumps clear and flowing
Apron drainage outlets to aerodrome storm network functioning
No standing water on apron 30 min after end of rainfall
Culvert at [Location 1] invert clear, headwalls intact, no structural cracking
Culvert at [Location 2] invert clear, headwalls intact, no structural cracking
Culvert at [Location 3] invert clear, headwalls intact, no structural cracking
All identified culverts no sedimentation reducing flow area > 25%
All culvert headwalls and wingwalls structurally intact, no separation from embankment

sections.title: SECTION 5 — UNPAVED AREA DRAINAGE (CHANNELS AND SWALES)

items.text: All open channels in runway strips free of vegetation blockage and sediment
All open channels in infield areas free of blockage
All swale slopes at minimum 1% longitudinal gradient to outlet
No channel bank erosion creating structural failure of channel
No channel blockage causing overflow onto adjacent safety areas
Saturated Zone 7 areas no expansion of flooded zone beyond mapped boundaries

validationRules: Every item marked NO SAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: DR-11 is intentionally absent — the source form's numbering skips from DR-10 to DR-12. Preserve this gap exactly; do not renumber.

DR-17/18/19 contain literal '[Location N]' placeholder text in the source document. Confirm with BACC whether these should be replaced with actual named culvert locations before go-live, or left as fill-in text per submission.
